Media, edits, favourites, archive flags and settings are processed on this device. No Gimbo Galerie account, analytics service or developer upload is used. Remove saved projects or app data to erase local app records; original media belong to your storage.

Folder/cloud backup is optional and starts only after you choose a destination and start or enable it. The selected provider processes files under its own policy. Disable automatic backup to stop scheduled transfers. Copies already uploaded remain with the provider until removed.

The developer receives no personal data, so there is no stored data to disclose, correct or delete. You remove local data by clearing the app data or uninstalling the app. The terms and privacy policy of the chosen provider apply to optional cloud backups. Full privacy policy: github.com/Hiarni/Gimbo-Gallery/blob/main/PRIVACY.en.md
